source: User-observed medium-speed walk from the position after Throné's opening battle to the next cutscene trigger, 2026-09-26
assumption: The user confirmed 57 walking updates to the next checkpoint. Running and mixed budgets currently estimate the same total; independent opening running/mixed measurements are unavailable.
limitation: UpdatePlayerStep checks displacement > PC_ONCE_STEP_LENGTH, decrements once and replaces PrePlayerPos with the current position. Excess displacement is discarded. Speed and switch locations can change update counts, so this is not a general movement-path simulator or an exact mixed-distance percentage. Flats measurements of 61 walk/56 run apply only to Flats, not this opening route.
zero_counter_policy: StepCount <= 0 enables encounters; a tie at the trigger is not considered safe. Cutscene-versus-encounter scheduling on that frame is unverified.
